note: Manistee NF campground on the Little Manistee River (a National Scenic Study River, known for steelhead and trout) in Lake County; about 16-20 sites with fire pits and picnic tables, plus walk-in riverside sites, and parking for 20 vehicles. Drive-in via FR 5202. A 1.5-mile trail connects the campground to the North Country National Scenic Trail. --Claude
summary: FS page: first-come only (no recreation.gov listing exists - searched), $30 single / $40 walk-in riverside (confirmed), vault toilets and potable water (confirmed), season Early May - Labor Day (in season.note), 50% Senior/Access on one site (stated). Not stated: site count, rig length, hookups, operator beyond the ranger district. Current Huron-Manistee alerts (April 2026 flooding: High Bridge Road closure in Manistee County; March 2026 storm in the Huron zone) don't touch this campground; only the standing North Country Trail order is listed on its page.
